def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in g:
        for x in r: cnt[x]+=1
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find pattern: connected component of non-bg cells with >1 cell? markers are isolated singles
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while stack:
                    r,c=stack.pop()
                    if (r,c) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((r,c)); comp.append((r,c))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and g[nr][nc]!=bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                                stack.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(comp)
    pattern=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]
    markers=[c[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # bbox and center of pattern
    rs=[r for r,c in pattern[0]]; cs=[c for r,c in pattern[0]]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    cr,cc=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2
    for (r,c) in markers:
        for (pr,pc) in pattern[0]:
            nr,nc=r+pr-cr,c+pc-cc
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w:
                out[nr][nc]=g[pr][pc]
    return out

def check(inp,exp):
    got=transform(inp)
    print(got==exp)
    return got
check(G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output'])
check(G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output'])
t=transform(G['Test input'])
